title: View directory structure as a tree
summary: Use the `tree` command to see the contents of a directory in a visual, hierarchical format. This helps you understand how files and folders are organized without scrolling through a long list.

steps.explain: Run the `tree` command with the `-L` flag to limit the depth of the directory tree displayed. Replace <NUM> with the number of levels you want to see.

placeholders.name: NUM
placeholders.description: The maximum depth of directories to display.

steps.expect: A list of files and folders indented to show their hierarchy, limited to the specified depth.
